      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FB1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Feedback" targetRef="Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FB2" sourceRef="Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="EndEvent_FeedbackHandled"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOnlineOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceivePhoneOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePhoneOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderMerge" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickAndPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_PickAndPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="SendTask_HandOver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="SendTask_HandOver" targetRef="SendTask_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="CatchEvent_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="CatchEvent_Delivered" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OrderFulfilment" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/order-fulfilment">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderPlacedOnline" name="Order placed via online platform"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderPlacedByPhone" name="Order placed by phone"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_HandoverToLogistics" name="Order handed over to logistics provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivered to customer address"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Customer feedback or return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfilment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Online Order Fulfilment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfilment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Logistics" name="Logistics Provider"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PlaceOrderOnline" name="Places order online" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_OnlineOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PlaceOrderPhone" name="Places order by phone" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_PhoneOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_HandoverToLogistics" name="Hand over order" sourceRef="SendTask_HandOver" targetRef="Participant_Logistics"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivered to customer address" sourceRef="Participant_Logistics" targetRef="CatchEvent_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or return" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="CatchEvent_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfilment" name="Online Order Fulfilment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Fulfilment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesSystem" name="Sales system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_OnlineOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_PhoneOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_SendTracking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MonitorShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CatchEvent_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordDelivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AfterDelivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderDelivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CatchEvent_FeedbackOrReturn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_FeedbackHandled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouse team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickAndPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateShippingLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_HandOver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OnlineOrder" name="Order placed via online platform">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderPlacedOnline" messageRef="Msg_OrderPlacedOnline"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PhoneOrder" name="Order placed by phone">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderPlacedByPhone" messageRef="Msg_OrderPlacedByPhone"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PickAndPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_HandOver" name="Hand over order to logistics provider" messageRef="Msg_HandoverToLogistics">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information to customer" messageRef="Msg_TrackingInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_Delivered" name="Delivered to customer address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DeliveryConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordDelivery" name="Record successful delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AfterDelivery" name="Further action required?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Customer feedback or return received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FeedbackOrReturn" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn" name="Handle feedback or return">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FeedbackHandled" name="Feedback or return handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_OnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="StartEvent_PhoneOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickAndPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_PickAndPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="SendTask_HandOver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="SendTask_HandOver" targetRef="SendTask_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="CatchEvent_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="CatchEvent_Delivered" targetRef="Task_RecordDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_RecordDelivery" targetRef="Gateway_AfterDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterDelivery" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterDelivery" targetRef="CatchEvent_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="CatchEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_HandleFeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="EndEvent_FeedbackHandled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
